description: Investor writes the change as "from £10k to £15k"; neither is a valid amount token, so no amounts and new_amount cannot be validated.

new_amount.void: £15k is not a valid amount (I-01: the k suffix makes the token invalid)

notes: £10k / £15k fail the C-EXT-3 boundary rule (letter k after the number), so rule_output.amounts is empty. new_amount annotated as void (the model can only quote "£15k", which fails I-01). currency GBP from the £ sign. See W2 question on how an unparseable amount field is scored.
